```{r}
# 2. Create scatter plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot of MPG vs Weight",
       x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
       y = "Miles per Gallon (MPG)") +
  theme_minimal()
plot(cars)
```
